attempts.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense), joining private network A (node1-node3, 10.10.1.0/24) and private network B (node2-node4, 10.10.2.0/24) across the transit network (node1 eth1 10.10.0.1/30, node2 vtnet1 10.10.0.2/30). Verified traffic between node3 and node4 is fully routed inside the encrypted tunnel (plaintext ICMP only visible on wg0; only encrypted UDP/51820 visible on the transit link). Restarted all four nodes one at a time, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery of interfaces, WireGuard handshake, routes, and end-to-end connectivity on each.
